_comment: Preferred free Nous models, best first. resolve_model.py tries these before the remaining free candidates (ordered by context length). Ids not currently free/probe-passing are skipped, so stale entries are harmless. Order follows measured CEO latency in Axiom bmh-company: laguna-xs-2.1 p50 3.3s (2026-10-27), laguna-s-2.1 p50 51s. meituan/longcat-2.5-preview was removed after Nous retired it (404 'no longer free') on 2026-10-27.
